name: Lewatit VP OC 1065, Young 2021 cold-transient + hot numerical extrapolation

evidence.basis: The original Young 2021 Toth and GAB coefficients, LDF rates and process heats are evaluated unchanged with IAPWS saturation in a named 20-120 C scenario. Measured coupled support remains 25-70 C. The 20 C side is an assumed continuation motivated by physically observed evacuation cooling, not cold-data validation, and it does not transfer the Low sample to Young or fit a cold correction.
evidence.not_for: validated 20 C equilibrium or coupling, validated 116 C equilibrium or coupling, hot adsorption/desorption rate prediction, hot-vacuum energy validation, measured humid-cycle accuracy, hardware qualification, cyclic steady state, lifetime or annual production.

shaped_material.basis: The app case supplies a dry shaped resin mass; the source measured resin sample is not a shaped device.
shaped_material.binder_support: Commercial resin beads are represented as the dry resin solid; no binder or support is added.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: The case particle diameter remains a transfer assumption.

evaluation_envelope.classification: explicit unvalidated cold-transient and hot numerical continuation

co2.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J Tables 2 and 4; process heat from SI Table S9

water.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J equations 5-8 and 25-26; process heat from SI Table S9
water.basis: Unchanged Young GAB coefficients evaluated with local p_H2O / IAPWS saturation. The measured water evidence is not spliced into the Young specimen.

water_evaluation_policy.original_cap_basis: GAB(0.55, 298.15 K) in the original implementation; not a directly measured experimental loading maximum
water_evaluation_policy.evaluation_cap_basis: round-up of the self-consistent unchanged-GAB maximum over 20-120 C and RH<=0.55
water_evaluation_policy.normalization_scope: CO2 target/helper evaluation only; raw ODE inventory, delta and energy remain unchanged

kinetics.evidence_status: Unchanged Young 2021 SI Table S9 process constants. Warm, humid transfer and hot-vacuum transfer remain assumptions, not measured validation.

equilibrium.class: unchanged source-reproduced Young fit outside its measured coupled domain

old_hot_package.policy: preserved byte-identical; this new scenario does not alter its defaults

low_package.policy: preserved byte-identical; no Low-to-Young sample transfer

saturation_pressure.reason: The original Buck implementation has no declared hot-validity interval; IAPWS is used only by this named extrapolation scenario.

measured_constraint.status: not spliced into the Young coefficient set

adsorbed_energy.basis: Constant CP_GAS and 70/46 kJ/mol process heats preserve the original convention.

assumptions: The measured coupled support remains 25-70 C and RH 0-0.55.
The 20 C lower boundary is an explicitly assumed continuation of the published correlations, motivated by the saved physical evacuation cooling trend; it is not cold-data validation.
All Young Toth and GAB coefficients are evaluated unchanged through the named 20-120 C numerical envelope.
IAPWS saturation replaces only the saturation correlation inside this separate scenario provider.
The actual evolving stored-water inventory drives the Young WADST CO2 target.
Negative stored water within the existing 1e-9 evaluation tolerance may be normalized only at the CO2-helper boundary; the raw state, delta and energy use the original value.
The corrected upper evaluation cap is derived from the unchanged GAB formula and does not alter the original implementation cap or source coefficients.
Cold-transient coupling, hot binary coupling, adsorption/desorption rates and energy transfer are unvalidated transfers.
Wilkins 110 C and Low 2023 measurements are diagnostic constraints, not fitted corrections or same-specimen validation.

validity.equilibrium: Measured coupled support ends at 25-70 C; the 20-25 C and 70-120 C outputs are conditional numerical continuations.
validity.water: Local IAPWS RH is constrained to 0-0.55; no cold or hot cross-temperature fit is adopted.
validity.cycle: Numerical scenario only; cold/hot rates, caloric closure, drainage and thermal lag are unvalidated.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: Equilibrated initialization is a numerical scenario state, not cyclic steady state.

uncertainty.statement: The calculation is authorized as a transparent named conditional scenario. No percentage accuracy statement, measured cold validation or measured 116 C validation follows.
